column1: # Source-owned test-evidence fragment for the faithful lexer port.

column8: note
Generated general/window/builtin keyword tables are asserted through the Rust TokenKind and canonical text.
All original single-character operator/punctuation vectors assert kind and source text.
All five original vectors assert Rust lexical class and literal span.
All original single/system-variable forms plus exact text for qualified variables execute.

UTF8 introducer and national-character introducer each produce CharsetIntroducer then string tokens; the source-owned charset registry vectors also reject registered-but-unsupported legacy introducers at the parser boundary.
All original literal classification vectors assert TokenKind, including exponent, numeric fallback, hex, bit, charset, and dot-edge cases.
Raw token spans are asserted; Go LexLiteral conversion belongs to the parser/value layer and is intentionally not duplicated in the neutral lexer token API.
Line/block/executable/feature comments and the odd conditional-comment close behavior assert complete token streams.
Quoted identifier unquoting, doubled backtick, and byte offsets are asserted.
String token boundaries and raw spans are covered; decoded escape values are owned by parser decode_string.
NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES token boundaries are covered; logical escape decoding stays in the parser layer.
Unicode identifiers, whitespace, NUL truncation, and digit-led identifier fallbacks assert exact text.
Executable-comment keyword/number spans and offsets match the Go scanner positions.
Known feature execution, unknown feature suppression, helper parsing, and offsets are asserted.
Recognized hint token and full comment text are asserted.
All original keyword-position hint vectors assert complete token-kind streams.
All six leading-zero/integer boundary values parse to the exact expected u64 from the lexer token.
ANSI_QUOTES identifier/string classification, doubled quote, adjacency, and repeated strings assert kind/text.
All original malformed string, quoted identifier, variable, and NUL inputs produce Invalid.
All min/max/reset and next-byte vectors execute against the source-faithful helper.
All valid, malformed, rewind, and next-byte feature-id vectors execute against the source-faithful helper.
